nodes.name: Proposition 4: Relative compactness of occupancy processes
nodes.statement: There exists a set of probability one $\Gamma_T \subset \Gamma_0$ with the following property. The sequences $\left\{\mathcal{A}_n(\omega) : n \geq 1\right\}$, $\left\{\mathcal{D}_n(\omega) : n \geq 1\right\}$ and $\left\{q_n(\omega) : n \geq 1\right\}$ are relatively compact for each $\omega \in \Gamma_T$ and have the property that the limit of every convergent subsequence is a function with Lipschitz coordinates, also for each $\omega \in \Gamma_T$.
labels: prop: relative compactness of occupancy state sample paths
